narrative: An employee was operating a hoist and while trying to unhook the basket the employee's right middle finger was caught by the hook and the fingertip was amputated.
true_event: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment

narrative: On 7/26/2018, an employee's finger was caught in an auger, resulting in a right middle finger amputation at the first digit. On 7/28/2018, an employee's fingers were caught in a belt and pulley powered by an electric motor, resulting in an amputation of the left index and middle fingers at the second knuckle. This record contains two separate events that were reported simultaneously to OSHA by the employer. These events are captured as one report.
true_event: Caught in or compressed by equipment or objects, unspecified

narrative: On August 29, 2021, an employee was cleaning dough from the roller of a chunker hopper. As he was removing a piece of dough, his left hand was caught by a roller of the chunker machine. He suffered an amputation of the index finger, as well as crushing injuries to the left middle and ring fingers.
true_event: Caught in running equipment or machinery during maintenance, cleaning

narrative: An employee was unloading a produce truck using a pallet jack. The momentum of a pallet as it came down pushed her into another pallet. She suffered an injury to the right ankle and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
true_event: Contact with objects and equipment, unspecified

narrative: An employee was cleaning the inside of an incline auger when the running blade amputated her right middle fingertip.
true_event: Caught in running equipment or machinery during maintenance, cleaning

narrative: An employee was moving a pumping unit into the top-dead-bottom position. He stood behind the pump jack motor and began pushing on the belt to help roll the pump unit. The unit moved and suddenly shifted. The employee then slipped and lost his balance. His left hand contacted the bottom belt and was pulled into and around the motor sheave, amputating his left pinky fingertip and lacerating and fracturing his left ring and middle fingers.
true_event: Caught in or compressed by equipment or objects, unspecified

narrative: On June 14, 2017, an employee was oiling the thumb of an excavator when the employee's hand became trapped between the excavator's bucket and thumb. The employee suffered left hand fractures and lacerations, requiring hospitalization.

narrative: An employee was cutting scrap with a vertical bandsaw when the back of the employee's hand contacted the blade and was lacerated. The employee was hospitalized.
